C:\Windows\System32
  RW NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM
        FILE_ALL_ACCESS
  RW BUILTIN\Administrators
        FILE_ALL_ACCESS
  R  BUILTIN\Users
        FILE_GENERIC_READ
        FILE_GENERIC_EXECUTE

C:\Users\testuser\Documents
  RW NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM
  RW DESKTOP-ABC\testuser
  R  BUILTIN\Administrators
